```{r}
#| label: setup

# Resolve paths relative to the project's DATA root (one level above this
# repo), where Data/ and the various analysis-output folders already live
# locally. These folders are NOT part of this git repository (see README) --
# they stay local / go to Dataverse, never to GitHub.
data_root <- dirname(here::here())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = data_root)
setwd(data_root)  # also set for interactive, chunk-by-chunk execution in RStudio
```

## Helpers/Constants 
```{r}
format_num <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x), NA,
    ifelse(abs(x) < 0.001 & x != 0,
           formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2),   # scientific for very small
           formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)))}   # fixed 3 decimals otherwise


APNS_ordered <- c("Pain","Avoidance","Reexperience","Hyperarousal",
                  "Anxious","Somatic","MentalFatigue","Depression","Nightmare","Sleep")

```
